# Cv (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`public-site`](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Renders one CV at `/cv/<documentId>`: the `page-cv-a` of that id, the `profile` as the contact card and the labels of `cvCommonText`, all read server-side and passed to the client view; a signed-in visitor refetches the data with their token ([public-site flow](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md)).

## Techniques

Page layout of web RULES "Page layout": `PageCv.tsx` (Server Component) loads through `PageCv.data.ts` (`loadPageCv`, React `cache`, shared by `generateMetadata` and the page); the three queries are read independently (public-site PS-2): a malformed id (`parseCvDocumentId`, no cms-api call) or a `pageCvA` that answers null (never mocked) is `notFound()` (HTTP 404); a failed `PageCvA` read with no mock is the no-CV-live state (HTTP 200, the sanitized `noCvText` or `LAST_RESORT_TEXT.noCvLive`); every state carries the robots tags `CV_ROBOTS_METADATA` (also set by `app/cv/layout.tsx` for the not-found render); the id reaches cms-api only as the `documentId` GraphQL variable; a failed `CvCommonText` leaves the labels out; a failed `Profile` leaves the contact card out. The four query strings (`PageCvA`, `Profile`, `CvCommonText`, `PageCvVisitor`) are in `PageCv.graphql.ts` (the selections written once) and run through `executeGraphql` in `PageCv.data.ts`; a failed profile or text is `null`, a failed `pageCvA` read is the no-CV-live state; the BFF route `GET /api/v1/cv` binds `answerCvRead` from the same file (its move to `/cv/{documentId}` is CPL-4). Server data first: anonymous visitors (and everyone's first paint) get the server-rendered data without a request; a signed-in session refetches per actor, signing out falls back to the server data, a failed refetch keeps the server CV with no message. Labels come from `cvCommonText` only (section titles from `summary`, `experiences`, `projects`, `skills`, `educations`, `languages`, `reference`; `teamSize` ("Team of 6"), `technologies`, `achievements`, `webLink` (live link), `projectLink` (repository link), `phone` (reference phone)); a label with no field (contact, loading, masked text, fallback name, link names, unnamed project) is left out, and with a null `cvCommonText` every label is left out. Loading is an empty busy `output`; no name means no `h1`; a masked value is left out when no masked text is provided, never shown raw; links show their URL; unsafe link targets render as text; richtext is sanitized on the server only (D13).

Layout and print (user 2026-11-19, the layout of the CV print demo): a header band (avatar, name, position, two-column contact list with icons), then About me, Experiences (company bar, roles with period on the right), Projects (panels), Skills (grouped by level in the order each level first appears), Educations, Languages, References. Colours are the `cv-*` tokens in `assets/styles/app.css`; every text tone stays readable in black-and-white print. Print: A4 `@page` in `app.css` (first page with no top margin), the site header hidden, blocks kept on one page (`break-inside-avoid`), tints printed as on screen (`print-color-adjust: exact`).

## Technologies

React, TanStack Query.

## Entry points

`PageCv` and its `generateMetadata` (rendered and re-exported by `app/cv/[documentId]/page.tsx`; `app/cv/page.tsx` is `notFound()`, `app/cv/layout.tsx` sets the robots metadata), `answerCvRead` (bound by `app/api/v1/cv/route.ts`).

## Where to change what

A field or label: `PageCv.graphql.ts` (selection and types) and `apis/server/graphql/mocks/PageCv.mock.ts`; a new section: a `<Name>Section.tsx` file plus one line in `PageCv.client.tsx`; contact items and the avatar: `ContactCard.tsx`; colours and paper size: `assets/styles/app.css`; who sees which data: `usePageCvData` in `PageCv.client.tsx`; what is loaded and how it fails: `PageCv.data.ts`.
